name: PROTECTOR Early Streamer Emission Lightning Conductor
shortDescription: Advanced ESE lightning protection system certified by Middle East Technical University, providing superior early streamer emission for extended coverage.
longDescription: PROTECTOR Early Streamer Emission (ESE) Lightning Conductor: Advanced active conductor that supplies energy from electrostatic field intensity variations in the air. Made from special materials to prevent chemical corrosion. Compact design with built-in protection mechanism against lightning discharge. Certified by Middle East Technical University. Made in India.
features: No coils, condensers, or Piezo crystals

name: Copper Bonded Conventional Type Lightning Arrester
shortDescription: Reliable conventional spike lightning arrester with copper bonded or aluminum construction for effective lightning protection.
longDescription: Trueblue Electrodes Conventional Lightning Rod (Spike Lightning Arrester): Metal rod or conductor mounted on top of buildings and electrically connected to ground through a wire. If lightning strikes the building, it preferentially strikes the rod and is conducted harmlessly to ground through the wire, preventing fire or electrocution. Includes rooftop network of conductors, multiple conductive paths from roof to ground, bonding connections to metallic objects, and grounding network. Copper bonded or aluminum construction. 120 kph wind speed survival rating. Made in India.

name: Stainless Steel Conventional Type Lightning Arrestor

Metal rod or conductor mounted on top of buildings and electrically connected to ground through a wire. If lightning strikes the building, it preferentially strikes the rod and is conducted harmlessly to ground, preventing fire or electrocution. 120 kph wind speed survival rating. Ideal for coastal and corrosive environments. Made in India.

name: Solar Earthing Kit - Complete Package
shortDescription: Complete earthing solution designed specifically for solar power installations with all necessary components.
longDescription: Trueblue Solar Earthing Kit: A comprehensive earthing solution specifically designed for solar power installations. This complete package includes copper bonded earthing rods, grounding clamps, connectors, earth enhancement compound, and all necessary hardware for a reliable solar grounding system. Designed to meet solar industry standards and ensure optimal performance and safety of solar installations. The kit provides complete protection against lightning strikes and electrical faults in photovoltaic systems. Made in India.

name: TBGIM Ground Improving Compound (50 Kg)
shortDescription: Premium ground enhancement compound IS 3043 compliant for reducing earth resistance and improving conductivity.
longDescription: TBGIM (Trueblue Ground Improving Material): Premium non-corrosive ground enhancement compound specifically formulated to reduce earth resistance and improve soil conductivity. IS 3043 compliant formulation ensures optimal performance in all soil conditions. The compound creates a stable, low-resistance environment around earthing electrodes, significantly improving their effectiveness. Non-toxic, eco-friendly composition with long-lasting performance. Maintains consistent low resistance even in dry or poor conductivity soils. Essential for achieving optimal earthing system performance. Made in India.
